title: CodyScript run configuration
description: How to run a program, kept apart from the program, which behaves the same whatever they are: its variables, and where a debugger pauses it. Either field may be left out. Limits aren't part of it: they're the host's. The engine also checks that every breakpoint names a step of the program (invalid_config).

variables.description: The run's initial variables, by name, visible to the whole program.

breakpoints.description: Where a debugger pauses the run: before each step a breakpoint names. Each must name at least one step.

breakpoint.description: A step to pause before, by its tag or by its path. Prefer the tag where the step has one: a path changes when the program around the step is edited, but a tag moves with its node.

path.description: The step at this JSON Pointer into the program, as errors use: "/do/1", "/fn/fee/do/0/set/fee", or "" for the program's root.
